hints.title: Recognizing 0/1 Cost
hints.text: If moving from (r, c) to (nr, nc) aligns with grid[r][c]'s direction, cost is 0. If you change the direction, cost is 1. All edges have weight 0 or 1. This is a classic 0/1 BFS.

hints.title: Deque Mechanism
hints.text: In BFS, queue elements are sorted by distance. If an edge has weight 0, the neighbor has the SAME distance as the current node, so push it to the FRONT of the deque! If weight 1, push it to the BACK. This maintains monotonic order without a heap!

hints.title: Early Termination
hints.text: The first time you pop (m - 1, n - 1) from the front of the deque, its distance is guaranteed to be minimal.

hints.title: Code Skeleton

complexity.notes: 0-1 BFS using deque with push-front for weight 0 and push-back for weight 1.
